job.job_title: Senior Java GenAI & Workflow Automation Engineer
job.job_description:
Experience: 9+ Years
Location: Mumbai / Bangalore (Hybrid)

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Java GenAI & Workflow Automation Engineer to design and build enterprise-grade AI-powered applications and workflow orchestration platforms. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in Java-based backend development, Generative AI technologies, and workflow automation frameworks to drive intelligent business process automation at scale.

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and architect scalable applications using Java and Spring Boot.
Build and integrate Generative AI solutions leveraging LLMs, AI Agents, RAG, and Agentic Workflows.
Develop workflow orchestration and automation solutions using platforms such as Camunda, Temporal, Conductor, or equivalent technologies.
Design microservices and APIs that integrate seamlessly with AI services and enterprise systems.
Create and optimize Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines using vector databases and knowledge repositories.
Implement AI-driven business workflows and process automation solutions.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define technical architecture and solution design.
Ensure application scalability, security, performance, and maintainability.
Mentor engineering teams and contribute to architectural decision-making.
Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and best practice initiatives.

Required Skills

Backend Development

Strong expertise in Java (11/17+)
Spring Boot
Microservices Architecture
REST APIs
Distributed Systems
SQL/NoSQL Databases

Generative AI

Generative AI / LLM-based Application Development
LangChain / LangChain4j
RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
AI Agents / Agentic AI
Prompt Engineering
OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, or similar LLM platforms
Vector Databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, Milvus)

Workflow Automation

Camunda / Temporal / Netflix Conductor
BPMN
Workflow Orchestration
Business Process Automation

Additional Skills

JavaScript / Node.js
Docker & Kubernetes
Kafka or Event-Driven Architecture
CI/CD Pipelines
AWS, Azure, or GCP

Preferred Qualifications

Experience building enterprise AI platforms or AI-powered business applications.
Knowledge of Multi-Agent Systems and Agent Orchestration.
Exposure to MCP (Model Context Protocol).
Strong architectural and stakeholder management skills.
Excellent communication and problem-solving abilities.

Experience Required

9+ years of overall software development experience.
Hands-on experience in Java, GenAI, and Workflow Automation implementations.
Prior experience in designing and delivering large-scale enterprise solutions.

Location: Mumbai / Bangalore
Employment Type: Full-Time
